1-1-1.lot: But on account of their accursed bellies they have miserable woes,
1-1-1.greek: ἀλλ' ἕνεκ' οὐλομένης γαστρὸς κακὰ κήδε' ἔχουσιν

lexicon.meaning: belly, gnawing appetite, raw bodily necessity
trouble, anxious care, grief

1-1-2.lot: neither to cast anchor stones nor to attach stern cables,
1-1-2.greek: οὔτ' εὐνὰς βαλέειν οὔτε πρυμνήσι' ἀνάψαι

lexicon.meaning: anchor-stone, resting place, mooring
stern-cables, lines that bind a vessel to shore

1-1-3.lot: being struck by the sword, and the water was becoming red with blood.
1-1-3.greek: ἄορι θεινομένων, ἐρυθαίνετο δ' αἵματι ὕδωρ

lexicon.meaning: sword, striking blade
to dye red, stain crimson

fragment.whisper: ...a trace of an ending in -n upon torn papyrus; the voice falls silent before the fourth throw...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.4 broken at left margin; unplaced scrap in Preisendanz PGM VII.

1-1-5.lot: stood holding a scepter, which Hephaistos produced by his labors.
1-1-5.greek: ἔστη σκῆπτρον ἔχων, τὸ μὲν Ἥφαιστος κάμε τεύχων

lexicon.meaning: staff of authority, scepter, pillar of rule
to fashion by toil, labor with skill

fragment.whisper: ...a lone omega lingers at the torn edge of the column, like a vow left unfinished...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.6; only traces of ink survive near the right fracture (cf. Maltomini 1995).

1-2-1.lot: amends I wish to make and to give a boundless ransom.
1-2-1.greek: ἂψ ἐθέλω ἀρέσαι δόμεναί τ' ἀπερείσι' ἄποινα

lexicon.meaning: to make amends, appease, heal a breach
ransom, recompense, price of reconciliation

1-2-2.lot: surely then the gods themselves have ruined your mind.
1-2-2.greek: ἦ τ' ἄρα δή τοι ἔπειτα θεοὶ φρένας ὤλεσαν αὐτοί

lexicon.meaning: mind, wits, seat of judgment
to ruin, undo, bring to naught

fragment.whisper: ...'...in the heart (thymōi)...' — the rest of the verse is eaten away by the sands...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.9; P. Bon. 3 preserves scant traces of dative singular ending.

fragment.whisper: ...'...far / long (makron)...' — distance or delay echoes from the frayed fibers...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.10; lacuna across central fibers (cf. P. Bon. 3 col. i).

1-2-5.lot: let it lie in the great hall. And I wish for your happy arrival
1-2-5.greek: κείσθω δ' ἐν μεγάρῳ· σὺ δέ μοι χαίρων ἀφίκοιο

lexicon.meaning: great hall, inner sanctuary of the house
to rejoice, arrive in gladness and safety

fragment.whisper: ...'...the gods (theoi)...' — their decree is effaced where the papyrus split...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.12; broken at left and center.

fragment.whisper: ...'...through the night (nykta)...' — shadow obscures the remainder of the line...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.13; fragmentary letters near column fold.

fragment.whisper: ...'...the open sea (ponton)...' — the ink washes out into salt and silence...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.14; abraded surface prior to line 15 (Il. 18.328).

1-3-3.lot: But Zeus does not accomplish for men all their purposes.
1-3-3.greek: ἀλλ' οὐ Ζεὺς ἄνδρεσσι νοήματα πάντα τελευτᾷ

lexicon.meaning: purpose, design, plan conceived in the mind
to bring to fulfillment, accomplish to the end

1-3-4.lot: I would even wish it, and it would be much better
1-3-4.greek: καί κε τὸ βουλοίμην, καί κεν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν

lexicon.meaning: to will, prefer, choose deliberately
more advantageous, wiser, of greater gain

1-3-5.lot: Then indeed would he smash all your fine show,
1-3-5.greek: τῷ κέ τοι ἀγλαΐας γε διασκεδάσειεν ἁπάσας

lexicon.meaning: splendor, outward pomp, proud display
to scatter abroad, shatter to pieces

1-3-6.lot: I also care about all these things, woman. But very terribly
1-3-6.greek: ἦ καὶ ἐμοὶ τάδε πάντα μέλει, γύναι· ἀλλὰ μάλ' αἰνῶς

lexicon.meaning: to be an object of care, weigh upon the heart
terribly, dreadfully, with grave intensity

fragment.whisper: ...'...with hands (chersin)...' — an action grasped at, yet lost in the tear of the scroll...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.19; gap between Il. 6.441 and Od. 17.66.

1-4-2.lot: speaking good things, but they were contriving evil things in their hearts.
1-4-2.greek: ἐσθλὰν ἀγορεύοντες, κακὰ δὲ φρεσὶ βυσσοδόμευον

lexicon.meaning: to speak openly in assembly, declare aloud
to build in the depths, brood secretly on schemes

1-4-3.lot: The glorious gifts of the gods are surely not to be cast aside,
1-4-3.greek: οὔ τοι ἀπόβλητ' ἐστὶ θεῶν ἐρικυδέα δῶρα

lexicon.meaning: to be cast aside, spurned, rejected
glorious, resplendent with honor

fragment.whisper: ...'...the spoken word (mython)...' — a counsel onceuttered, now worn from the reed...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.22; missing in P. Lond. 121, unrecovered in P. Oxy. 3831.

fragment.whisper: ...'...homecoming (noston)...' — the road back is broken across the papyrus...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.23; severely abraded line preceding Il. 21.223.

1-4-6.lot: These things, Zeus-nurtured Skamander, will be as you order.
1-4-6.greek: ἔσται ταῦτα, Σκάμανδρε διοτρεφές, ὡς σὺ κελεύεις

lexicon.meaning: cherished by Zeus, divinely nourished
to bid, command, set in motion

1-5-1.lot: a joy to your enemies, and a disgrace to yourself?
1-5-1.greek: δυσμενέσιν μὲν χάρμα, κατηφείην δὲ σοὶ αὐτῷ;

lexicon.meaning: source of gloating joy to rivals
downcast eyes, shame, dejection

1-5-2.lot: Within this very year, Odysseus will arrive here,
1-5-2.greek: τοῦδ' αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ἐλεύσεται ἐνθάδ' Ὀδυσσεύς

lexicon.meaning: the revolution of the year, path of light
to come, arrive at the appointed threshold

1-5-3.lot: No use indeed to you, since you will not lie clad in them,
1-5-3.greek: οὐδέν σοί γ' ὄφελος, ἐπεὶ οὐκ ἐγκείσεαι αὐτοῖς

lexicon.meaning: use, profit, avail, practical benefit
to lie wrapped within, rest in possession of

1-5-4.lot: And to the victor are to go the woman and the possessions.
1-5-4.greek: τῷ δέ κε νικήσαντι γυνὴ καὶ κτήμαθ' ἕποιτο

lexicon.meaning: to prevail, conquer, win the contest
possession, treasure, earned estate

1-5-5.lot: the rule of the many is no good. Let there be one ruler.
1-5-5.greek: οὐκ ἀγαθὸν πολυκοιρανίη· εἷς κοίρανος ἔστω

lexicon.meaning: rule of many, divided command, discordant authority
sovereign leader, single guiding will

1-5-6.lot: And the gateway is full of ghosts, and full also is the courtyard,
1-5-6.greek: εἰδώλων δὲ πλέον πρόθυρον, πλείη δὲ καὶ αὐλή

lexicon.meaning: phantom, unsubstantial shade, haunting image
gateway, outer porch, threshold of entry

1-6-1.lot: We have won great honor. We have killed glorious Hektor,
1-6-1.greek: ἠράμεθα μέγα κῦδος· ἐπέφνομεν Ἕκτορα δῖον

lexicon.meaning: radiant glory, decisive triumph, divine favor
to slay, overcome a formidable adversary

1-6-2.lot: Who would undertake and complete this task for me?
1-6-2.greek: τίς ἄν μοι τόδε ἔργον ὑποσχόμενος τελέσειε;

lexicon.meaning: to take upon oneself, pledge, undertake
to accomplish, carry through to completion

1-6-3.lot: Not even if his gifts to me should be as numerous as the grains of sand and particles of dust,
1-6-3.greek: οὐδ' εἴ μοι τόσα δοίη ὅσα ψάμαθός τε κόνις τε

lexicon.meaning: sea-sand, countless grains along the shore
dust of the earth, shifting powder

fragment.whisper: ...'...care / trouble (kēdos)...' — a faint warning of burden on the frayed margin...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.34; first of three consecutive lines lost at the foot of the column.

fragment.whisper: ...'...gifts (dōra)...' — whether offered or refused, the papyrus keeps its secret...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.35; foot of column broken away (cf. P. Bon. 3).

fragment.whisper: ...'...the fulfillment / end (telos)...' — the final throw of the first hexad is effaced...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. i.36; bottom margin lost.

2-1-1.lot: For no island is made for driving horses or has broad meadows,
2-1-1.greek: οὐ γάρ τις νήσων ἱππήλατος οὐδ' εὐλείμων

lexicon.meaning: fit for driving horses, open and level
rich in meadows, lush pastureland

2-1-2.lot: in the past, when you were boys, did you listen to your
2-1-2.greek: ὑμετέρων τὸ πάροιθεν ἀκούετε, παῖδες ἐόντες

lexicon.meaning: in time past, formerly, from elder days
to heed, listen to ancestral counsel

fragment.whisper: ...'...the mind / wits (phrenas)...' — a whisper of inward counsel among torn reeds...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. ii.39; upper left damage in second column.

fragment.whisper: ...'...fire (pyr)...' — a spark glints through the lacuna before vanishing...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. ii.40; lacuna spanning three lines (39-41).

fragment.whisper: ...'...the way / journey (hodon)...' — the path is interrupted by a rift in the scroll...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. ii.41; preceding Il. 9.378.

2-1-6.lot: His gifts are hateful to me, and I honor him not a whit.
2-1-6.greek: ἐχθρὰ δέ μοι τοῦ δῶρα, τίω δέ μιν ἐν καρὸς αἴσῃ

lexicon.meaning: hateful, unwelcome, tainted by enmity
allotted worth, measure, estimation

2-2-1.lot: an only beloved heir to many possessions,

lexicon.meaning: dearly beloved, born late and cherished
accumulated wealth, inherited substance

fragment.whisper: ...'...report / renown (kleos)...' — a rumor carried on the wind, half-erased...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. ii.44; triple-two throw lost in central tear.

fragment.whisper: ...'...grief / pain (algos)...' — a sharp ache noted on the damaged leaf...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. ii.45; abraded papyrus strip.

fragment.whisper: ...'...light / deliverance (phaos)...' — a gleam breaking through the torn fibers...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. ii.46; immediately precedes Od. 24.19.

2-2-5.lot: So they thronged about him. And near
2-2-5.greek: ὣς οἵ γ' ἀμφὶ περὶ κεῖνον ὅμιλεον· ἀγχίμολον δέ

lexicon.meaning: to throng together, gather in close company
drawing near, approaching close at hand

2-2-6.lot: and fashioning lies out of what nobody could see.
2-2-6.greek: ψεύδεά τ' ἀρτύνοντας, ὅθεν κέ τις οὐδὲ ἴδοιτο

lexicon.meaning: falsehood, fabricated tale, illusion
to contrive, fit together cunningly

2-3-1.lot: be valiant, that later generations may also speak well of you.
2-3-1.greek: ἄλκιμος ἔσσ', ἵνα τίς σε καὶ ὀψιγόνων εὖ εἴπῃ

lexicon.meaning: valiant, stout-hearted, courageous in defense
born hereafter, future generations

2-3-2.lot: leaning on the grave marker over a barrow heaped up by men

lexicon.meaning: upright stone pillar, grave marker, boundary
burial mound, earthen barrow of memory

2-3-3.lot: go. You have a way, and beside the sea your ships
2-3-3.greek: ἔρχευ· πάρ τοι ὁδός, νῆες δέ τοι ἄγχι θαλάσσης

lexicon.meaning: open road, way forward, passage
the sea, the waiting waters of departure

2-3-4.lot: You will be proved a liar, and will not go on to fulfill your word.
2-3-4.greek: ψευστήσεις, οὐδ' αὖτε τέλος μύθῳ ἐπιθήσεις

lexicon.meaning: to prove false, fall short of one's word
consummation, fulfillment, final seal

2-3-5.lot: And his mother for her part continued the lament amid a flood of tears,
2-3-5.greek: μήτηρ δ' αὖθ' ἑτέρωθεν ὀδύρετο δάκρυ χέουσα

lexicon.meaning: to lament, keen in sorrow
tear poured forth in grief

2-3-6.lot: Not even if remaining for five or six years
2-3-6.greek: οὐδ' εἴ κεν πεντάετές γε καὶ ἑξάετες παραμίμνων

lexicon.meaning: to tarry beside, remain steadfastly waiting
full cycle of a year, long span of time

2-4-1.lot: So he spoke, and ordered Paion to administer a cure.
2-4-1.greek: ὣς φάτο, Παιήονι δ' ἀνώγειν ἰήσασθαι

lexicon.meaning: Paieon, divine physician and healer of wounds
to heal, cure, restore to wholeness

2-4-2.lot: These things, unhappy man, will I accomplish and do for you.
2-4-2.greek: ταῦτά τοι, ὦ δύστηνε, τελευτήσω τε καὶ ἔρξω

lexicon.meaning: hard-pressed, travailing, weighed down by fortune
to do, perform, enact in deed

2-4-3.lot: How can you propose to render toil useless and ineffectual?
2-4-3.greek: πῶς ἐθέλεις ἅλιον θεῖναι πόνον ἠδ' ἀτέλεστον;

lexicon.meaning: fruitless, vain, dissolved like sea-foam
hard toil, strenuous effort

2-4-4.lot: a thing delayed, late of fulfillment, whose fame will never perish.
2-4-4.greek: ὄψιμον ὀψιτέλεστον, ὅου κλέος οὔ ποτ' ὀλεῖται

lexicon.meaning: late of fulfillment, ripening after long delay
imperishable renown, enduring report

2-4-5.lot: Sooner would you grow weary and return to your native land.
2-4-5.greek: πρίν κεν ἀνιηθεὶς σὴν πατρίδα γαῖαν ἵκοιο

lexicon.meaning: to grow weary, be vexed by prolonged waiting
ancestral land, true home and origin

2-4-6.lot: to go, that he may bring poisonous drugs from there,
2-4-6.greek: ἐλθεῖν, ὄφρα ἔνθεν θυμοφθόρα φάρμακ' ἐνείκῃ

lexicon.meaning: soul-destroying, spirit-corroding
potent herb, drug, poison or remedy

2-5-1.lot: Husband, you departed from life young, and left me behind as a widow
2-5-1.greek: ἆνερ, ἀπ' αἰῶνος νέος ὤλεο, κὰδ δέ με χήρην

lexicon.meaning: vitality, span of life, marrow of existence
bereft, widowed, left solitary

2-5-2.lot: in which way I will for sure accomplish everything and how it will be brought to pass,
2-5-2.greek: ᾗ περ δὴ φρονέω τε καὶ ὡς τετελεσμένον ἔσται

lexicon.meaning: to intend, resolve with clear mind
to bring to pass, seal into reality

2-5-3.lot: Offer me not honey-tempered wine, honored mother,
2-5-3.greek: μή μοι οἶνον ἄειρε μελίφρονα, πότνια μῆτερ

lexicon.meaning: honey-sweet to the mind, lulling the senses
revered, queenly, worthy of honor

fragment.whisper: ...'...vital force / resolve (menos)...' — strength surging beneath the eroded ink...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. ii.64; lost between Il. 6.264 and Il. 6.432.

fragment.whisper: ...'...the house / hall (domon)...' — threshold and roof-beam faded into the papyrus...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. ii.65; lacuna paired with line 64.

2-5-6.lot: Do not orphan your son and make your wife a widow.
2-5-6.greek: μὴ παῖδ' ὀρφανικὸν θήῃς χήρην τε γυναῖκα

lexicon.meaning: orphaned, left defenseless without a guardian
bereft, stripped of companionship

2-6-1.lot: would that they might now eat their last and final meal here.
2-6-1.greek: ὕστατα καὶ πύματα νῦν ἐνθάδε δειπνήσειαν

lexicon.meaning: uttermost, final, at the very limit
to feast, consume a meal

2-6-2.lot: It is not meet for a man who speaks in the Council to sleep all the night through,
2-6-2.greek: οὐ χρὴ παννύχιον εὕδειν βουληφόρον ἄνδρα

lexicon.meaning: all night long, through the whole watch
counsel-bearing, charged with leadership

2-6-3.lot: What's wrong with you, that you took this wrath into your heart?
2-6-3.greek: δαιμόνι', οὐ μὲν καλὰ χόλον τόνδ' ἔνθεο θυμῷ

lexicon.meaning: bitter gall, smoldering wrath, resentment
spirited breast, seat of passion and breath

2-6-4.lot: But who knows if he will one day return and punish them for their violent deeds?
2-6-4.greek: τίς δ' οἶδ' εἴ κέ ποτέ σφι βίας ἀποτίσεται ἐλθών;

lexicon.meaning: violent force, arrogance, outrage
to exact reckoning, restore balance

2-6-5.lot: wives I will provide for both and furnish possessions
2-6-5.greek: ἄξομαι ἀμφοτέροις ἀλόχους καὶ κτήματ' ὀπάσσω

lexicon.meaning: partner of the hearth, wedded companion
to bestow, grant generously, endow

2-6-6.lot: we may try the bow and complete the contest.

lexicon.meaning: bow, instrument of tension and aim
trial of strength, decisive contest

3-1-1.lot: For it's no reproach to flee evil, nor by night.
3-1-1.greek: οὐ γάρ τις νέμεσις φυγέειν κακόν, οὐδ' ἀνὰ νύκτα

lexicon.meaning: righteous blame, reproach, indignation
to slip away, escape impending harm

3-1-2.lot: Be mindful of every form of valor. Now you needs must
3-1-2.greek: παντοίης ἀρετῆς μιμνήσκεο· νῦν σε μάλα χρή

lexicon.meaning: excellence, valor, highest capability
to call to mind, awaken inner mastery

3-1-3.lot: as a widow at home. And the boy is still just a baby,
3-1-3.greek: χήρη ἐνὶ μεγάροισι· πάϊς δ' ἔτι νήπιος αὔτως

lexicon.meaning: hall, household, shelter
helpless infant, unready, vulnerable

3-1-4.lot: But do you in no wise enter the moil of Ares,
3-1-4.greek: ἀλλὰ σὺ μὲν μή πω καταδύσεο μῶλον Ἄρηος

lexicon.meaning: to plunge into, enter the thick of
din of struggle, grinding turmoil of conflict

3-1-5.lot: For amid misfortune mortals quickly grow old.
3-1-5.greek: αἶψα γὰρ ἐν κακότητι βροτοὶ καταγηράσκουσιν

lexicon.meaning: hardship, adversity, wearing affliction
to age prematurely, wither under strain

fragment.whisper: ...'...allotted portion (moira)...' — fate's measure is written on the missing scrap...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. ii.78; gap of two lines between Od. 19.360 and Od. 6.201.

fragment.whisper: ...'...the deed / work (ergon)...' — the labor itself is swallowed by the lacuna...
fragment.apparatus: P. Lond. 121 col. ii.79; damaged transition at 3-2-1.

3-2-2.lot: Such a man is not alive nor will be born,
3-2-2.greek: οὐκ ἔσθ' οὗτος ἀνὴρ διερὸς βροτὸς οὐδὲ γένηται

lexicon.meaning: living, nimble, pulsing with vital moisture
mortal human, earth-born

3-2-3.lot: Of a truth, child, there's nothing really wrong with this,
3-2-3.greek: ναὶ δὴ ταῦτά γε, τέκνον, ἐτήτυμον οὐ κακόν ἐστι

lexicon.meaning: true, genuine, aligned with reality
child, one addressed with protective care

3-2-4.lot: Now is it no longer possible for him to find escape from us,
3-2-4.greek: οὔ οἱ νῦν ἔτι γ' ἔστι πεφυγμένον ἄμμε γενέσθαι

lexicon.meaning: having escaped, slipped beyond reach
our grasp, the closing net of pursuit

3-2-5.lot: we will ransom with bronze and gold, for it is within.
3-2-5.greek: χαλκοῦ τε χρυσοῦ τ' ἀπολυσόμεθ'· ἔστι γὰρ ἔνδον

lexicon.meaning: to ransom, release from bondage by payment
within the house, stored in reserve

3-2-6.lot: drink, and do not vie with younger men.
3-2-6.greek: πῖνέ τε, μηδ' ἐρίδαινε μετ' ἀνδράσι κουροτέροισιν

lexicon.meaning: to wrangle, contend, provoke rivalry
younger, hot-blooded, vigorous

3-3-1.lot: where are you fleeing, turning your back like a craven in the ranks?
3-3-1.greek: πῇ φεύγεις μετὰ νῶτα βαλών, κακὸς ὣς ἐν ὁμίλῳ;

lexicon.meaning: the back, turned in retreat
the press of battle, the watching crowd

3-3-2.lot: Would that such a man be called my husband
3-3-2.greek: αἲ γὰρ ἐμοὶ τοιόσδε πόσις κεκλημένος εἴη

lexicon.meaning: spouse, chosen partner, steadfast ally
to name, acknowledge openly

3-3-3.lot: plants her head in heaven and walks upon the earth.
3-3-3.greek: οὐρανῷ ἐστήριξε κάρη καὶ ἐπὶ χθονὶ βαίνει

lexicon.meaning: to plant firmly, fix high in the heavens
the solid earth beneath one's stride

3-3-4.lot: But Zeus does not accomplish for men all their purposes.
3-3-4.greek: ἀλλ' οὐ Ζεὺς ἄνδρεσσι νοήματα πάντα τελευτᾷ

lexicon.meaning: purpose, design, plan conceived in the mind
to bring to fulfillment, accomplish to the end

3-3-5.lot: and nodded for his army to survive and not to perish.
3-3-5.greek: νεῦσε δέ οἱ λαὸν σόον ἔμμεναι οὐδ' ἀπολέσθαι

lexicon.meaning: to nod in divine assent, seal a promise
safe, preserved whole, unharmed

3-3-6.lot: Would that you had not pled with the noble son of Peleus,

lexicon.meaning: to entreat, implore, humble oneself in petition
blameless, proud, unyielding

3-4-1.lot: Honey-sweet wine has the best of you, which others also
3-4-1.greek: οἶνός σε τρώει μελιηδής, ὅς τε καὶ ἄλλους

lexicon.meaning: to wound, impair judgment, befuddle
honey-sweet, seductively pleasant

3-4-2.lot: Act in whatever way your mind is moved, and no longer hold back.
3-4-2.greek: ἔρδ' ὅπῃ δή τοι νόος ἔπλετο, μηδ' ἔτ' ἐρώει

lexicon.meaning: mind, clear intent, inward purpose
to hold back, slacken, hesitate

3-4-3.lot: For it is fated for both to turn the same ground red
3-4-3.greek: ἄμφω γὰρ πέπρωται ὁμοίην γαῖαν ἐρεῦσαι

lexicon.meaning: it is fated, bound by shared destiny
to redden the earth, pour out lifeblood

3-4-4.lot: keep on shooting like this, if haply you may become a light to the Danaans
3-4-4.greek: βάλλ' οὕτως, αἴ κέν τι φόως Δαναοῖσι γένηαι

lexicon.meaning: to let fly the arrow, strike the mark
light of deliverance, beacon of rescue

3-4-5.lot: as there is no one who could keep the dogs off your head,
3-4-5.greek: ὡς οὐκ ἔστιν ὅς σῆς γε κύνας κεφαλῆς ἀπαλάλκοι

lexicon.meaning: scavenging hound, relentless pursuer
to ward off, shield, drive away

3-4-6.lot: You will not kill me, since I am for sure not subject to Fate.
3-4-6.greek: οὐ μέν με κτενέεις, ἐπεὶ οὔ τοι μόρσιμός εἰμι

lexicon.meaning: to slay, destroy
subject to fate, appointed to fall

3-5-1.lot: staying right here you would help me watch over this house
3-5-1.greek: ἐνθάδε κ' αὖθι μένων σὺν ἐμοὶ τόδε δῶμα φυλάσσοις

lexicon.meaning: to abide, stay rooted in place
to guard, keep watch over the house

3-5-2.lot: Get out of the gateway, old man, or it won't be long before you're dragged out by the foot.
3-5-2.greek: εἶκε, γέρον, προθύρου, μὴ δὴ τάχα καὶ ποδὸς ἕλκῃ

lexicon.meaning: to yield, give way from the threshold
to drag by force, cast out

6-2-4.greek: ἀλλ' ἄγε δὴ φέρε τόξον· τάχ' οὐκ εὖ πᾶσι πιθήσεις

lexicon.meaning: to bring forward without hesitation
to try to please every voice in the crowd

6-2-5.lot: But hurry into battle, and rouse the other soldiers.
6-2-5.greek: ἀλλ' ὄρσευ πόλεμόνδε, καὶ ἄλλους ὄρνυθι λαούς

lexicon.meaning: to rouse into motion, lead from the front
the company of allies awaiting a signal

6-2-6.lot: For mighty Herakles, not even he escaped his doom,
6-2-6.greek: οὐδὲ γὰρ οὐδὲ βίη Ἡρακλῆος φύγε κῆρα

lexicon.meaning: mighty strength, heroic force
appointed limit of mortal destiny

6-3-1.lot: amends I wish to make and to give a boundless ransom.
6-3-1.greek: ἂψ ἐθέλω ἀρέσαι δόμεναί τ' ἀπερείσι' ἄποινα

lexicon.meaning: to make amends, appease, heal a breach
ransom, recompense, price of reconciliation

6-3-2.lot: And let him stand up among the Argives and swear an oath to you
6-3-2.greek: ἐν δὲ μέσοισ' Ἀργείοισιν ἀναστὰς ὅρκον ὀμόσσαι

lexicon.meaning: to stand up publicly in witness
solemn oath, binding covenant

6-3-3.lot: The man is nearby. Our search will not be long, if you are willing
6-3-3.greek: ἐγγὺς ἀνήρ, οὐ δηθὰ ματεύσομεν, αἴ κ' ἐθέλῃτε

lexicon.meaning: near at hand, already present
to seek after, search for counsel

6-3-4.lot: and not quite suddenly, and a very god should be the cause?
6-3-4.greek: ἐξαπίνης προφανέντ', αὐτὸς δὲ θεὸς προτιάγοι;

lexicon.meaning: suddenly, in an unlooked-for instant
to come to light, appear before all

6-3-5.lot: Verily, these things have already happened, and not otherwise could
6-3-5.greek: ἦ δὴ ταῦτά γε, ἑτοῖμα τετεύχαται, οὐδέ κεν ἄλλως

lexicon.meaning: already accomplished, manifest fact
to fashion irreversibly

6-3-6.lot: On now, follow close! In action numbers make a difference.
6-3-6.greek: ἀλλ' ἐφομαρτεῖτον καὶ σπεύδετον· δέ τε πλεόνων ἔργον ἄμεινον

lexicon.meaning: to follow close together, act in concert
combined numbers, shared effort

6-4-1.lot: surely then the gods themselves have ruined your mind.
6-4-1.greek: ἦ τ' ἄρα δή τοι ἔπειτα θεοὶ φρένας ὤλεσαν αὐτοί

lexicon.meaning: mind, wits, seat of judgment
to ruin, undo, bring to naught

6-4-2.lot: Take heart, and let your thoughts not be of death.
6-4-2.greek: θάρσει, μηδέ τί τοι θάνατος καταθύμιος ἔστω

lexicon.meaning: to take courage, cast off dread
weighing on the spirit

6-4-3.lot: by her wailing she rouse from sleep her household servants,

lexicon.meaning: to cry aloud, wake the household with lament
member of the house, domestic circle

6-4-4.lot: Come now in strict silence, and I shall lead the way,
6-4-4.greek: ἀλλ' ἴθι σιγῇ τοῖον, ἐγὼ δ' ὁδὸν ἡγεμονεύσω

lexicon.meaning: strict silence, unhurried discretion
to lead the way safely through the mist

6-4-5.lot: are there ears for hearing, and sense and respect are dead.
6-4-5.greek: οὔατ' ἀκουέμεν ἐστίν, ἀπώλετο δὲ νόος αἰδώς

lexicon.meaning: sober judgment, discernment
reverence, restraint, moral proportion

6-4-6.lot: as he was growing old. But the son did not grow old in his father's armor.
6-4-6.greek: γηράσκοντ'· ἀλλ' οὐχ υἱὸς ἐν ἔντεσι πατρὸς ἐγήρα

lexicon.meaning: to grow old in peace
borrowed armor that exceeds one's measure

6-5-1.lot: to return home and behold the day of homecoming.
6-5-1.greek: οἴκαδέ τ' ἐλθέμεναι καὶ νόστιμον ἦμαρ ἰδέσθαι

lexicon.meaning: homeward, back to one's true center
of homecoming, the day of safe return

6-5-2.lot: Apollo of the silver bow did strike the one, still sonless,
6-5-2.greek: τὸν μὲν ἄκουρον ἐόντα βάλ' ἀργυρότοξος Ἀπόλλων

lexicon.meaning: without a son, leaving a solitary line
of the silver bow, sudden stroke of Apollo

6-5-3.lot: then you may hope to see your loved ones and reach
6-5-3.greek: ἐλπωρή τοι ἔπειτα φίλους τ' ἰδέειν καὶ ἱκέσθαι

lexicon.meaning: bright hope, grounded expectation
beloved kin, welcoming circle

6-5-4.lot: As for you two, I will tell you exactly how it will be.
6-5-4.greek: σφῶϊν δ', ὡς ἔσεταί περ, ἀληθείην καταλέξω

lexicon.meaning: unconcealed truth, plain reality
to recount in exact order

6-5-5.lot: For so shall I proclaim, and it will be accomplished too.
6-5-5.greek: ὧδε γὰρ ἐξερέω, τὸ δὲ καὶ τετελεσμένον ἔσται

lexicon.meaning: to proclaim solemnly, declare without wavering
brought to pass, unalterably fulfilled

6-5-6.lot: and I shall send him wherever his heart and spirit urge him.
6-5-6.greek: πέμψω δ' ὅππῃ μιν κραδίη θυμός τε κελεύει

lexicon.meaning: to send forth with safe-conduct
the heart's own compass and desire

6-6-1.lot: idiot? You'll soon pay when the swift hounds devour you
6-6-1.greek: δαιμόνι', αἶψά τοι αὖθι κύνες ταχέες κατέδονται

lexicon.meaning: swift, sudden reckoning
to devour, consume the reckless

6-6-2.lot: You would learn what mighty hands I have to back me up.
6-6-2.greek: γνοίης χ' οἵη ἐμὴ δύναμις καὶ χεῖρες ἄαπτοι

lexicon.meaning: active power, backed capability
invincible, untouchable hands

6-6-3.lot: In no wise do I think he will in that event take you for himself, nor is it proper.
6-6-3.greek: οὔ τί σε ἔλπομαι αὐτὸν ἄξεσθαι, οὐδὲ ἔοικεν

lexicon.meaning: to suppose, harbor an unrealistic expectation
it is fitting, proper to the order of things

6-6-4.lot: here we gather, waiting day after day.

lexicon.meaning: to haunt the same place, pace in circles
waiting day after day in suspense

6-6-5.lot: to reach decision making secret plans. Nor yet now to me
6-6-5.greek: κρυπτάδια φρονέοντα δικαζέμεν· οὐδέ τί πώ μοι

lexicon.meaning: clandestine, kept in secret counsel
to reach a judgment, decide behind closed doors

6-6-6.lot: Don't dare get it into your mind to escape from me, Dolon.
6-6-6.greek: μὴ δή μοι φύξιν γε, Δόλων, ἐμβάλλεο θυμῷ

lexicon.meaning: flight, evasive escape
to harbor in the mind, entertain a vain hope

hemeralogia.source: PGM VII. 155-167 (Hemeromanteiai kai horai / Days and Hours for Divination)
hemeralogia.description: Ancient Greco-Egyptian lunar-month schedule preserved immediately after the Homeromanteion in P. Lond. 121 (PGM VII), prescribing propitious windows and forbidden days for casting lots.

dawn.label: At Dawn
dawn.counsel: The rising light of Apollo clears the mist; cast in the early morning hours.

noon.label: At Midday
noon.counsel: When Helios stands at the zenith and shadows are shortest, the oracle speaks clearly.

afternoon.label: In the Afternoon
afternoon.counsel: The slanting afternoon sun favors the casting of the lots.

whole_day.label: Throughout the Whole Day
whole_day.counsel: An open and propitious day; the shrine welcomes inquiry at any waking hour.

dawn_and_afternoon.label: At Dawn and in the Afternoon
dawn_and_afternoon.counsel: Propitious at the two thresholds of light—dawn and afternoon—avoiding the glare of noon.

do_not_use.label: Do Not Use (Apophras / Forbidden Day)
do_not_use.counsel: The papyrus warns 'μὴ χρῶ' (do not consult) on this day; omens drawn now are veiled or turbulent.
